hooks.description: pigeon stream-refuse-guard: HARD-REFUSE (O-02) — blocks any `pigeon send-test`/`notify` shell command routing a cold/marketing-tagged send through a transactional-only provider (postmark/resend-transactional) = account-death (SCN-05/PIT-02); also the auto-pause-on-spike branch (O-24). Exit 2 = block; appends an append-only `outcome:blocked` line to logs/runs.jsonl (Observability §10).
